dedicated.name: Teo's Night Crow Seal

why_by_stat.Crush: Mainly useful in PVP. Reduces the enemy’s Block Rate 1%-for-1%, making it easier for Teo to land Critical Hits and deal more damage to tanky enemies.
why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by Teo by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story:
"It is precisely in this moment, when darkness has befallen us, that we need someone to watch us more than ever. If only there were a keen-eyed crow to take flight through the night."

On a small hill beneath the rising full moon, Teo and Shiroda talked about the crows that flew at night and the guardians who watched over the moonlight, a dialogue through which they affirmed their shared values. Much later, Teo recalled that night and declared to Orly that their organization shall be named the "Night Crows," thereby steeling his unwavering determination.

lore: On the Aisha continent, beyond the northern forests of the Endless Rampart, lay Shinji — a land beyond Imperial rule. Deep within this territory lay a massive rift, created during the ancient war, that has remained open to this day. Even so, Aisha has remained at peace thanks to the powerful guardians who prevented the monsters that emerged from its depths from spreading across the world. These guardians were the Night Elves, a tribe that stood watch over this site since the ancient Ragnarok of yore. And Teo... was born among them. Though Shinji was a land isolated from the outside world, Teo, under his father's influence, dreamed of venturing beyond its borders. In time, in order to perfect the swordsmanship required to guard the rift, he eventually left Shinji behind.
